evidence: Row 43 structural and finite execution checks pass. Frozen tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has render=constraints=0.0 only under [gates], weights functional=.6/polish=.2/visual=.2, and functional floor .05. The gate criteria are binary and all_pass (gates/render/judge.toml:14-21; constraints/judge.toml:14-21); each criterion's weight=1 is internal to its gate and is absent from shaped reward. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 only evaluates scored dimensions after both gates pass, sums only [weights], requires functional strictly greater than .05, and returns reward0 otherwise. test.sh:212 clears stale scored output; :213-222 runs gates then score.py and exits on a failed or invalid gate before :224 can run scored. Scoring policy, score.py and test.sh are byte-equal to the frozen template, respectively SHA256 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba, 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e and bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa. Actual network-none isolated Docker execution of this unchanged test.sh/score.py with a preserved local RewardKit stub completed nine cases in 11.516s (per-row-review/evidence/43/run-manifest.json). Either failed gate invoked only gates, created no scored directory and yielded zero; malformed boolean gate also skipped scored and zeroed. Passing gates with all scored values zero yielded zero. With polish=visual=1, functional0 yielded reward0 despite weighted_score.4, functional.05 yielded reward0 despite weighted_score.43, and functional.05001 yielded .43. Function-only yielded .6, and all scored values1 yielded1. All 45 assertions passed. Broken-app challenge: hash-verified local/gate-witness/results.json (fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75) and its driver/log record an HTTP200 no-op requisition create with no fresh-context requisition/offer; it fails the basic storage observation, while the golden succeeds. This observation is narrower than execution of every gate field assertion. A dead-approval variant preserves working intake and also passes that basic witness, as constraints/judge.toml:25 explicitly keeps approval in scored outcomes; gates alone give it no mass. Conforming-alternative challenge: a legitimate empty operational desk with generated IDs, ordinary optional-field defaults and equivalent money/date representations is explicitly permitted by render/judge.toml:23 and constraints/judge.toml:23-25; no mandatory seed roster, ID prefix, schema, route or layout was found in this gate. This alternative assessment is source-based, not a provider trial. The floor intentionally permits partial apps above .05 to receive earned craft credit; it cannot be read as a guarantee that all incomplete apps score zero. All 37 verification-local source bindings and the cited raw hashes were checked (verified-bindings.json). These are source, scripted-browser and synthetic orchestration facts only; no configured app-judge grade, measured reward distribution, Oracle/model score, or full configured timing is claimed.
